certifiedResults.metadataNotes: County presidential totals transcribed from the Arizona Secretary of State signed 2024 General Election canvass. The SOS-hosted PDF is Cloudflare-protected for automated command-line download, so the local PDF was downloaded from a public mirror of the same signed canvass while the Source Planner keeps the SOS canvass URL as the official source of record.

reviewCharts.warning: Arizona review rows are partial county-local coverage from official Cochise and Greenlee precinct summary PDFs. They should not be read as statewide review coverage until remaining county precinct sources are collected.

turnout.sourceTitle: Voter Registration Statistics - Historical Election Information
turnout.notes: Loaded as a statewide-only warning row from the Arizona Secretary of State historical election information table. The source reports election-wide ballots cast, registered voters, and voter turnout percentage.

certifiedResults.title: Arizona official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential rows are loaded from a machine-readable transcription of the Arizona Secretary of State signed 2024 General Election canvass. The source CSV is reconciled to its Totals row during the state build.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Arizona Secretary of State signed statewide canvass for the November 5, 2024 General Election.

wardDetail.title: Arizona partial precinct review rows
wardDetail.detail: Official Cochise and Greenlee county precinct summary PDFs provide precinct-level President and U.S. Senate rows. The app loads those 60 rows as partial county-local review coverage and labels Arizona incomplete until the remaining county precinct sources are collected.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official county precinct summary PDFs downloaded during advisory expansion; parser reconciles loaded county precinct sums against county presidential totals.

turnout.title: Arizona statewide turnout summary
turnout.detail: Statewide turnout is loaded from the Arizona Secretary of State voter registration statistics page. The historical election table reports 2024 registered voters, ballots cast, and turnout percentage.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Arizona Secretary of State voter registration statistics page, Historical Election Information table.
